Class TurnOrderSpace

java.lang.Object
mesos.order.TurnOrderSpace
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class TurnOrderSpace extends Object implements Serializable
A single space on the TurnOrderTile. Holds a food bonus and a flag indicating whether this is the last (penalty) space.

    • TurnOrderSpace

      public TurnOrderSpace(int position, int foodBonus, boolean lastSpace)
      Creates a turn-order space.
      Parameters:
      position - zero-based position on the tile (0 = first in turn order)
      foodBonus - food granted when a totem is placed here (0 for no bonus)
      lastSpace - true if this is the penalty space (last position)
